intent: Dark-first SaaS hero: headline lines blur in, then a pointer-tilted 3D stack of three CSS-drawn app windows assembles; one accent marks the block a comment just moved.

stack.animation: motion/react (variants with custom delays, useMotionValue, useSpring, useTransform, animate)
stack.fonts: font-display (Geist), font-serif (Instrument Serif italic for the emphasis word), font-sans

layout.grid: @container root; 12 cols from @5xl (64rem): copy 5, stack 7; stacked below
layout.stage: fixed 640×560 scaled to its container by ResizeObserver into a motion value
layout.calendar: 40px hour gutter, 9:00–18:00 at 31px per hour, 5 day columns

typography.figures: 30px display tabular points-left; tabular rating score

color.accent: #ff6a3d via the accent prop: today dot, now line, the moved block, the moved chip, focus rings only
color.tones: solid ink/90 · muted ink/7% · hatch dashed ink/20 over an ink/7% 135° hatch · accent
color.chart: ink line, ink/7% area, ink/30 dashed ideal
color.avatars: ink solid or ink/12%, inside ink/35 hairline rings

motion.trigger: useInView once at 20% for the copy; the stack has its own 30% trigger; ease [0.22,1,0.36,1]
motion.copy: headline lines rise 12px from blur(8px), 500ms, 65ms apart; body 0.24s, actions 0.29s, rating 0.34s; stars pop 40ms apart; score counts 0→4.8 with a clearing 3px blur
motion.windows: calendar 0.22s, burndown 0.32s, thread 0.40s: rise 28px from blur(8px), 700ms; filter dropped at rest
motion.calendar: header, hairlines and hour rules draw (scaleX, 15ms apart), column rules draw down, blocks drop in by column then time (y -6, scaleY 0.82→1, blur 4px, 420ms), now line draws at 0.56s
motion.burndown: one progress value (0.44s, 550ms) clips line and area from the left, moves the tip dot and counts points down to today's figure; status pill lands after
motion.thread: messages rise 70ms apart while avatar rings draw (pathLength); composer last
motion.payoff: moved chip at 0.64s, accent block drops 14px into Thursday at 0.72s
motion.tilt: springs 120/18/0.6 from window pointer position; rotateY -20→-4°, rotateX 14→2°; mouse only
motion.ambient: each window drifts ±7px on a 6–8.6s CSS loop, paused offscreen
motion.reducedMotion: fixed rotateX 8° rotateY -12° pose, no drift, one 150ms fade, numbers set instantly

responsive.narrow: copy then stack; actions stack vertically below @md; stage scales to width

accessibility: stage role=img with a descriptive aria-label
Secondary text uses at least 65% ink opacity on these surfaces; quiet typography must remain readable in both themes.
